settings.editor: Elder Shaman Abhay Oyun

Shaman Abhay Oyun is a shamanic elder of an ancient tradition of Siberian Shamanism. Throughout his life, he has traveled across 40 countries in search of ever new knowledge and spiritual insight, offering spiritual wisdom, humanitarian support, protective rituals, and direct energetic healing to those in need.

At the end of his long journey and teachings, his spiritual protectors sent him to North America with an important mission, one that is meant to raise the life of all humanity to a new stage of evolution: the awakening of the Sixth Race.

After communicating with Abhay Oyun, people often call him the Master of ancient traditions, because he knows and understands all religions and their rituals, and also has vast experience in the practice of spiritual perfection and can give advice and help in any area and situation of life.

Global Impact

“When you reconnect with your wild nature, trauma doesn't just heal — it transforms into power.”

— Shaman Abhay Oyun

Called the World Shaman and Guardian of Our Planet, Abhay Oyun has dedicated his life to responding to global crises — natural disasters, wars, humanitarian emergencies — through the ancient lens of shamanic intervention.

Book a Consultation →

2004 Japan — Mount Fuji

2,500 people gathered at the base of Mount Fuji under Abhay's guidance. Shaman chiefs from North America and Asian tribes united in ceremony for the first time.

2007 South Russia

Major peace conferences and large spiritual gatherings where prayers and sacred rituals were held to bring peace and healing to the war-torn region.

2015 Chile

When earthquakes, volcanic ash, and severe drought converged on Chile, Abhay led ceremonies to shift the collective energetic field and support recovery.

2022 Ukraine

During the New Year's Retreat 2021–2022, Abhay received a vision of the invasion. Sacred ceremonies were organized across Europe to focus healing energy on the region.

:root {
  --sao-speed-1: 48s;
  --sao-speed-2: 54s;
  --sao-gap: 22px;
  --sao-h: 310px;
  --sao-h-tablet: 220px;
  --sao-h-mobile: 168px;
  --sao-radius: 20px;
  --sao-fade-w: 180px;
  --sao-bg: #F9F6F0;
  --sao-row-gap: 22px;
}

/* Container Fade Masks */
#sao-sect-v5, #sao-col-v5, #sao-col-v5 > .elementor-widget-wrap,
#sao-col-v5 > .elementor-column-wrap > .elementor-widget-wrap {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* The marquee container (Section/Column) */
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::before,
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: var(--sao-fade-w);
  z-index: 10;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::before {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sao-bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
}
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::after {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--sao-bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Force Gallery into horizontal track */
.sao-marquee-row {
  margin-bottom: var(--sao-row-gap) !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .elementor-image-gallery {
  display: flex !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  gap: var(--sao-gap) !important;
  width: max-content !important;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* Direction-specific animations */
.sao-row--left  .gallery { animation: saoLeft  var(--sao-speed-1) linear infinite; }
.sao-row--right .gallery { animation: saoRight var(--sao-speed-2) linear infinite; }

/* Pause on hover */
.sao-marquee-row:hover .gallery { animation-play-state: paused; }

@keyframes saoLeft  {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
@keyframes saoRight {
  from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
  to   { transform: translateX(0); }
}

/* Image & Figure Styles */
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-item {
  margin: 0 !important;
  width: auto !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img {
  height: var(--sao-h) !important;
  width: auto !important;
  min-width: 180px;
  max-width: 520px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--sao-radius);
  display: block;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(26,20,16,0.09), 0 1px 4px rgba(26,20,16,0.05);
  transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1),
              box-shadow 0.55s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.045) translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(26,20,16,0.16), 0 4px 12px rgba(26,20,16,0.08);
}

/* Responsive Adjustments */
@media (max-width:1024px) {
  :root {
    --sao-h: var(--sao-h-tablet);
    --sao-fade-w: 80px;
    --sao-gap: 16px;
    --sao-row-gap: 16px;
  }
}
@media (max-width:767px) {
  html, body { overflow-x: hidden !important; max-width: 100vw; }
  :root {
    --sao-h: var(--sao-h-mobile);
    --sao-fade-w: 48px;
    --sao-gap: 12px;
    --sao-row-gap: 12px;
    --sao-radius: 12px;
    --sao-speed-1: 32s;
    --sao-speed-2: 36s;
  }
  .sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img:hover {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(26,20,16,0.09);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .gallery { animation: none !important; }
}
</style>

<script>
/**
 * SAO Gallery — Native Loop Controller
 * Clones the gallery items once for seamless infinite scrolling.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var initGalleryLoop = function() {
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.sao-marquee-row .gallery');
    rows.forEach(function (gallery) {
      if (!gallery || gallery.getAttribute('data-sao-looped')) return;
      
      // Clone all gallery items to create a seamless loop
      var items = gallery.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item');
      if (items.length === 0) return;

      items.forEach(function(item) {
        var clone = item.cloneNode(true);
        clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        gallery.appendChild(clone);
      });

      gallery.setAttribute('data-sao-looped', 'true');
    });
  };

  // Run on load and after potential Elementor frontend refreshes
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initGalleryLoop);
  
  // For Elementor Editor: Re-run when widgets are changed
  if (window.elementorFrontend) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function() {
      initGalleryLoop();
    });
  }
  
  // Immediate fallback run
  setTimeout(initGalleryLoop, 500);
})();
</script>
